outcome.technical:
audit-task.py: new _CHANGE_CLAUSE regex and _only_asks_for_test(resolution) (audit-task.py ~3134-3160): true when the resolution opens with a test-ask (_ASKS_FOR_TEST.match) and no later clause asks for a change. _fix_scope returns a new key testOnly (all targeted findings test-only; ~line 3378). _fix_task_args: with no caller --tests-mode and testOnly, mode = regression plus a note 'regression, not tdd: <ids> only ask(s) for a test over behaviour the code already has ... prove it by mutation ... declare that as its falsifier' (~line 3538), taking precedence over the newTests->tdd arm, so it applies even when the finding names a source file; the unplaced-test remedy sentence names --tests-mode regression in that case. An explicit --tests-mode still wins; a resolution that also asks for a change (e.g. 'Fix the label and add a test', 'Add a test ..., then rename the prop') stays tdd (unknown verbs fall to tdd, the old default). Requirement clauses: (1) test-only resolution -> regression: audit-task.py:3538; (2) mutation-proof note: audit-task.py:3539-3545, asserted 'mutation' + finding id in test; (3) even when it names a source file: tests use components/Why.tsx and lib/x.ts; (4) not tdd when the resolution asks for more: ALLOW arms.
